title: From sales associate to regional manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger in 90 seconds
summary: Everyday shop-floor job that most viewers have done or seen, climbing to the person who plans a whole region.

beats.label: title
beats.voice: From sales associate to regional manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger in ninety seconds.
onScreen: From sales associate to regional manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger
beats.visual: Title scene: full-bleed room, a ladder on the right, the five steps below, small Ledger in the rt_associate outfit waving on the bottom step; a dashed arrow climbs to the top; the title card and the 90-second pill appear on the title words

beats.label: rung 1 THE ASSOCIATE
beats.voice: First, Ledger is the sales associate, in a store apron and name tag.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (rt_associate: coral store apron over a white tee, name tag, lanyard with a till key). Header THE ASSOCIATE. Ledger alone, scale 3.2, coral apron and name tag; two arrows pop in on 'apron' and 'name tag'; a clothes rail behind him

beats.label: rung 1 THE ASSOCIATE
beats.voice: Then he greets shoppers, and rings up each sale at the till.
beats.visual: A shopper walks in and waves; Ledger scans a shirt at a till and the receipt prints

beats.label: rung 1 THE ASSOCIATE
beats.voice: He restocks shelves, and tells his supervisor what runs low.
beats.visual: Ledger folds shirts onto a shelf and hands a stock note to a small supervisor figure

beats.label: rung 1 THE ASSOCIATE
beats.voice: So on this rung, he sells everything himself.
beats.visual: Slider dial at 0.06 on 'Sells'; Ledger holds a shirt toward the shopper

beats.label: climb 1 to 2
beats.voice: After that, he climbs to department supervisor.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 1 to rung 2; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 2 DEPT SUPERVISOR
beats.voice: Now he leads one department, and schedules the sales associates.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (rt_supervisor: teal polo, headset, clipboard). Header DEPT SUPERVISOR. Three associate figures appear one by one; Ledger points at them with a clipboard

beats.label: rung 2 DEPT SUPERVISOR
beats.voice: Then he writes the weekly rota, and checks each stock note.
beats.visual: A weekly rota grid fills with names; Ledger ticks a stock note from the associate

beats.label: rung 2 DEPT SUPERVISOR
beats.voice: So he sells a little less, and starts to plan.
beats.visual: Slider moves to 0.35; the rota grid stays behind him

beats.label: climb 2 to 3
beats.voice: Then he climbs again, to store manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 2 to rung 3; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 3 STORE MANAGER
beats.voice: As store manager, he runs the store, and answers for its sales.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (rt_manager: navy blazer over a white shirt, pocket square, store keys on belt). Header STORE MANAGER. Wide shot of the shop with Ledger at the door; a sales bar chart grows on the wall

beats.label: rung 3 STORE MANAGER
beats.voice: Then he sets the store budget, and hires new associates.
beats.visual: A budget meter fills; a new associate figure in an apron walks in and shakes his hand

beats.label: rung 3 STORE MANAGER
beats.voice: He also turns sales figures into the next promotion.
beats.visual: A sales chart turns into a sale poster that the supervisor hangs up

beats.label: climb 3 to 4
beats.voice: Next, he steps up as area manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 3 to rung 4; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 4 AREA MANAGER
beats.voice: Now he oversees several stores, and coaches each store manager.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (rt_area: charcoal suit, lanyard with ID card, travel bag). Header AREA MANAGER. Org chart: Ledger on top, three small store icons below, three manager figures

beats.label: rung 4 AREA MANAGER
beats.voice: Then he reviews each store's sales, and agrees its targets.
beats.visual: Three report sheets slide in; a target line is drawn on each

beats.label: climb 4 to 5
beats.voice: Finally, he reaches the top rung, as regional manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 4 to rung 5; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: Now he sets the plan for the region, and reports to head office.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (rt_regional: black suit, gold pocket square, glasses, grey temples). Header REGIONAL MANAGER. A region map with store pins; a report goes up to a head office building

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: He agrees each area's budget, and hardly sells anything himself.
beats.visual: Three budget meters, one per area; Ledger holds no shirt

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: Yet he answers for every store in the region.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.95 on 'Plans'; all store pins light up

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: So with each rung, Ledger sold less, and planned more.
beats.visual: Five Ledgers on the ladder, all five tags ticked, the slider runs from the bottom word to the top word

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics.
onScreen: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics

caption:
From sales associate to regional manager, the job changes on every rung

The sales associate serves shoppers and restocks shelves, and the department supervisor runs the rota. Then the store manager owns the budget and the promotions. Finally, the area and regional managers plan for several stores at once

So each rung up, you sell less yourself and plan more. Walk up the ladder with Ledger and note which rung you are on

sources.claim: Retail sales workers greet customers, recommend products, run the register, restock and track inventory; many move into supervisory or managerial roles
Retail manager duties (lead a store team, stock, promotions, budgets, recruiting, reporting) and the path sales assistant, supervisor or departmental manager, then several stores across a region
